sources_tested: Targeted June/fasciculus-alter searches; exact two-fascicle bibliographic verification through Cambridge bibliography, Open Library and WorldCat; Google Play and Online Books Page availability check; local corpus search for transcription.
open_text_result: No reusable open transcription of the June material was located. The independent 1912 fasciculus alter and its June scope are confirmed, but catalogues and the free Google Play reading listing do not provide a documented reusable Greek text.
open_text_license: Open Library/Cambridge results are bibliographic information only; no text licence was established.
scan_result: Google Play lists an 838-page free ebook of the historical set, while Hathi is US-only. Neither route supplied machine-readable rights or a page-quality audit, so neither is cleared for scan acquisition.
scan_rights: Availability to read does not establish image-reuse permission. Page-level quality and rights must be audited before any transfer; no image or OCR was acquired.
next_action: Request/locate a rights-explicit source for fasc. alter pp. 1–124, then visually audit the June pages before adding it to the scan queue.
notes: The June record belongs to the 1912 second fascicle and is distinct from the February/March Moscow-manuscript portions. No inference is made from the 1970 reprint licence status.
